name: Sleep + stress + immune defence

outputs.label: Chance the going-around cold gets through

overlay.caption: short sleep + stress hormones → weaker defence → the cold going around gets through

does: Shows immune defence dropping with less sleep than about 8 hours
Shows long-lasting stress lowering immune defence too
Shows the two together lowering it most, so a cold that's going around is more likely to get through
doesnt: Measure any real person — the numbers are illustrative teaching values
Include handwashing, how many germs are around, or anyone's health
Say that sleep or stress cause colds; colds come from viruses passed between people
limits.text: This is a simplified learning model. Real people vary with age, fitness and health. The numbers are illustrative, not measurements of any real person.
limits.wellbeing: If you feel run down for weeks, or stress feels like too much, talk with an adult you trust.

sources: NIH News in Health: sleep and your health; stress and your health (student overviews)
